meta.input: reanalysis/out/per_image.csv (reproduced exactly by local re-inference; no inference re-run here)
meta.leaf_rules: rust = abaxial face only; American leaf spot = mean of the two faces (IoU = mean of face IoUs, severity = mean of face severities)
meta.primary_rule_for_model_output: rule of the disease the model was trained for (rust models: abaxial face; leaf-spot models: mean of both faces); alternatives reported as sensitivity analyses
meta.grades: G0 < 0.5% <= G1 < 5% <= G2 < 20% <= G3 (predicted grade from predicted leaf severity; rust reference grade from reference severity; leaf-spot reference grade = annotator's visual grade)

thresholds.>0%: any predicted lesion pixel on the leaf-level face(s)

meta.proportion_ci: Wilson score, two-sided 95%, no continuity correction
meta.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of leaves, percentile 95% CI, numpy default_rng seed 20260927; paired comparisons use the same leaf indices for both models
meta.healthy_coverage: 21 healthy rust-pack TEST leaves are available locally (EARTH healthy controls collected 12, 15 and 22 June 2026); the paper reported 54. The other 33 are not in the local pack, so the published 54-leaf counts cannot be reproduced locally beyond these 21.
meta.lesion_location_face_sets: Cross-disease 'lesion_location' measures (share of predicted lesion pixels inside the reference lesion mask, lesion IoU, off-lesion severity) are given for two face sets: 'model_rule_faces' = the faces the model reads (rust models: abaxial; leaf-spot models: both faces), i.e. the same faces behind pred_sev, grade and >=0.5%; and 'leaf_rule_faces' = the faces of the leaf's own-disease rule (rust leaves: abaxial; leaf-spot leaves: both faces). The two sets are identical for correct-disease runs and differ for every cross-disease run. 'Off-lesion' = predicted lesion pixels outside the reference lesion mask; this includes lesion margins as well as distant tissue (not separated here).
meta.json_precision: all values at full float precision; display rounding is applied once, in make_md.py

definition_check: The manuscript defines a healthy-leaf false positive as ANY predicted lesion pixel and reports 0/54 for four models. Local re-inference with the exact published protocol (raw argmax in letterbox space; it reproduces Tables 2/4 exactly) gives at least one predicted lesion pixel on 7–21 of the 21 local healthy test leaves, depending on the model. These 21 leaves are part of the published 54, so the published counts cannot have come from the any-pixel rule under this protocol. They are compatible with a severity threshold: the highest leaf-level predicted severity on a local healthy leaf is 0.41% under the paper's leaf-level rules, and the highest single-face value is 0.54%. The training kernels define a healthy-leaf false positive as predicted severity ≥5% per image. The threshold behind the published 54-leaf counts could not be recovered.

specificity_published_54.note: Published counts (any predicted lesion pixel) on 54 healthy test leaves; not reproducible locally beyond the 21 leaves above.
